name: link
title: Link
description: A native <a href>, unchanged, with the register's underline drawn beneath it: quiet is a plain hairline underline; warm draws an ink line in on hover or focus and back out on leave; playful is the underline as a kolam line, one continuous wave with a small knotted loop. Forced colours bring back the browser's own underline.

budget.reason: Decision 0005: 12 KB of behaviour plus 8 KB for each of three skins. Today about 6.1 KB: behaviour (link.js + link.core.js) 3.4 KB, skins quiet 0.2 KB, warm 1.3 KB, playful 1.1 KB.
